description: Mileage totals and month/client/purpose/category breakdowns; country-aware IRS/CRA cents-per-mile/km deduction estimates. Use for mileage this year/by month/for Acme, business miles last quarter or deduction estimate. Supports YoY/MoM/QoQ comparisons. Returns message/data with totalDistance, optional deductionEstimate/breakdown/comparison/sampleMeta.

dateRange.description: One period variant matching user wording.

query.description: Natural language mileage question (e.g., 'mileage this year', 'miles driven for Acme client')

name: get_mileage_summary

outputSchema.description: Returns message + data; no success flag on the inline path.

success.description: Present only on the error branch (out of scope) / async path.
